title: Google is silently linking your phone number across all signed-in accounts
title_zh: 谷歌正在悄悄地将您所有已登录账户中的电话号码关联起来

paragraphs.en: Affiliate links on Android Authority may earn us a commission. Learn more.
paragraphs.zh: Android Authority 上的联盟链接可能会为我们带来佣金。了解更多。

paragraphs.en: Brady Snyder / Android Authority Add Android Authority on Google: Preferred Source Google Discover TL;DR Google now automatically verifies and attaches your phone number to every Google account signed in on your Android device without explicit prompts. Google updated its documentation between August and October 2025 to reflect this opt-out behavior, which links numbers across secondary, work, and alt profiles. Users can turn off “Verify phone numbers automatically” in their Android device’s Google settings page, but previously linked numbers must be manually removed from each Google account’s Personal Info page.
paragraphs.zh: Brady Snyder / Android Authority 在 Google 上添加 Android Authority 为首选来源 Google Discover TL;DR（太长不看版）：对于在您的 Android 设备上登录的每一个 Google 账号，Google 现在会自动验证并关联您的手机号码，且不会弹出明确提示。 Google 在 2025 年 8 月至 10 月间更新了其文档，以反映这一可退出行为，该行为会将号码关联到副号、工作账号和备用账号等配置文件中。 用户可以在其 Android 设备的 Google 设置页面中关闭「自动验证电话号码」，但先前已关联的号码必须从每个 Google 账号的个人信息页面中手动移除。

sents.en: Brady Snyder / Android Authority Add Android Authority on Google: Preferred Source Google Discover TL;DR Google now automatically verifies and attaches your phone number to every Google account signed in on your Android device without explicit prompts.
sents.zh: Brady Snyder / Android Authority 在 Google 上添加 Android Authority 为首选来源 Google Discover TL;DR（太长不看版）：对于在您的 Android 设备上登录的每一个 Google 账号，Google 现在会自动验证并关联您的手机号码，且不会弹出明确提示。

sents.en: Google updated its documentation between August and October 2025 to reflect this opt-out behavior, which links numbers across secondary, work, and alt profiles.
sents.zh: Google 在 2025 年 8 月至 10 月间更新了其文档，以反映这一可退出行为，该行为会将号码关联到副号、工作账号和备用账号等配置文件中。

sents.en: Users can turn off “Verify phone numbers automatically” in their Android device’s Google settings page, but previously linked numbers must be manually removed from each Google account’s Personal Info page.
sents.zh: 用户可以在其 Android 设备的 Google 设置页面中关闭「自动验证电话号码」，但先前已关联的号码必须从每个 Google 账号的个人信息页面中手动移除。

paragraphs.en: Your Android phone is deeply integrated with a number of Google services, but a quiet background mechanism is currently causing a stir among users. A growing number of Android users are only now learning that Google automatically verifies and associates their phone number with every Google account logged into their device, without any explicit confirmation prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 你的 Android 手机深度集成了众多 Google 服务，但一个默默在后台运行的机制目前正在用户中引发轩然大波。 越来越多的 Android 用户直到现在才了解到，Google 会自动将他们的电话号码与登录其设备上的每个 Google 账号进行验证和关联，而不会弹出任何明确的确认提示。

sents.en: Your Android phone is deeply integrated with a number of Google services, but a quiet background mechanism is currently causing a stir among users.
sents.zh: 你的 Android 手机深度集成了众多 Google 服务，但一个默默在后台运行的机制目前正在用户中引发轩然大波。

sents.en: A growing number of Android users are only now learning that Google automatically verifies and associates their phone number with every Google account logged into their device, without any explicit confirmation prompt.
sents.zh: 越来越多的 Android 用户直到现在才了解到，Google 会自动将他们的电话号码与登录其设备上的每个 Google 账号进行验证和关联，而不会弹出任何明确的确认提示。

paragraphs.en: As spotted in a recent Reddit thread, users report receiving confirmation emails out of the blue from “noreply-phone-verification@google.com” stating that their phone number has been verified. The feature, known in Google settings as “Phone number verification,” links your active phone number across all Google accounts signed in on the same phone, including secondary profiles, work accounts, and throwaway handles.
paragraphs.zh: 正如最近一个 Reddit 帖子中所发现的，用户报告称突然收到了来自“noreply-phone-verification@google.com”的确认邮件，称他们的电话号码已被验证。 该功能在 Google 设置中称为“电话号码验证”，它将你在同一部手机上登录的所有 Google 账号中正在使用的电话号码关联起来，包括辅助个人资料、工作账号和一次性账号。

sents.en: As spotted in a recent Reddit thread, users report receiving confirmation emails out of the blue from “noreply-phone-verification@google.com” stating that their phone number has been verified.
sents.zh: 正如最近一个 Reddit 帖子中所发现的，用户报告称突然收到了来自“noreply-phone-verification@google.com”的确认邮件，称他们的电话号码已被验证。

sents.en: The feature, known in Google settings as “Phone number verification,” links your active phone number across all Google accounts signed in on the same phone, including secondary profiles, work accounts, and throwaway handles.
sents.zh: 该功能在 Google 设置中称为“电话号码验证”，它将你在同一部手机上登录的所有 Google 账号中正在使用的电话号码关联起来，包括辅助个人资料、工作账号和一次性账号。

paragraphs.en: While our team has not seen these specific notification emails land in our own inboxes, several colleagues checked their device settings and found the auto-verification toggle was quietly enabled across their active devices.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然我们的团队并未在自己的收件箱中看到这些特定的通知邮件，但几位同事检查了他们的设备设置，发现自动验证开关在他们的所有活跃设备上都被悄然启用了。

paragraphs.en: Google’s support documentation has long noted that it periodically re-verifies your device’s phone number to keep communication and recovery features up to date. However, this support page was updated sometime between August and October 2025 to add this rather aggressive behavior of turning on phone number verification by default, as well as adding all phone numbers to all Google accounts signed in on the device:
paragraphs.zh: Google 的支持文档长期以来一直指出，它会定期重新验证您设备的电话号码，以确保通信和恢复功能保持最新状态。 然而，这个支持页面在 2025 年 8 月至 10 月之间的某个时间被更新，加入了这种相当激进的行为，即默认开启电话号码验证，并将所有电话号码添加到登录该设备的所有 Google 账号中：

sents.en: Google’s support documentation has long noted that it periodically re-verifies your device’s phone number to keep communication and recovery features up to date.
sents.zh: Google 的支持文档长期以来一直指出，它会定期重新验证您设备的电话号码，以确保通信和恢复功能保持最新状态。

sents.en: However, this support page was updated sometime between August and October 2025 to add this rather aggressive behavior of turning on phone number verification by default, as well as adding all phone numbers to all Google accounts signed in on the device:
sents.zh: 然而，这个支持页面在 2025 年 8 月至 10 月之间的某个时间被更新，加入了这种相当激进的行为，即默认开启电话号码验证，并将所有电话号码添加到登录该设备的所有 Google 账号中：

paragraphs.en: As you’d imagine, silently associating a phone number(s) across multiple accounts poses obvious privacy headaches for anyone who intentionally segregates their primary SIM from secondary accounts. Long-time Android users are bound to be caught off guard by this change, since this wasn’t an opt-out feature before.
paragraphs.zh: 正如你所想，在多个账号之间静默关联手机号，对于任何有意将主 SIM 卡与次要账号分开使用的人来说，都会带来明显的隐私隐患。 长期使用安卓的用户难免会被这一变化打个措手不及，因为此前这并不是一个可以选择退出（opt-out）的功能。

sents.en: As you’d imagine, silently associating a phone number(s) across multiple accounts poses obvious privacy headaches for anyone who intentionally segregates their primary SIM from secondary accounts.
sents.zh: 正如你所想，在多个账号之间静默关联手机号，对于任何有意将主 SIM 卡与次要账号分开使用的人来说，都会带来明显的隐私隐患。

sents.en: Long-time Android users are bound to be caught off guard by this change, since this wasn’t an opt-out feature before.
sents.zh: 长期使用安卓的用户难免会被这一变化打个措手不及，因为此前这并不是一个可以选择退出（opt-out）的功能。

paragraphs.en: If you would rather keep your phone number decoupled from secondary accounts, you can disable the feature through your Android device:
paragraphs.zh: 如果您宁愿将手机号码与辅助账号解耦，可以通过 Android 设备禁用该功能：

paragraphs.en: Note that turning off the phone number verification toggle only prevents future linking. If Google has already attached your number across secondary accounts, you will need to open your Google Account Personal Info page , head to Contact info > Phone , and manually remove the number from each profile where it doesn’t belong.
paragraphs.zh: 请注意，关闭电话号码验证开关只能防止未来的关联。 如果谷歌已经将你的号码关联到了多个次要账户上，你需要打开谷歌账户的个人信息页面，前往联系信息 > 电话，并手动从每个不属于该号码的个人资料中将其移除。

sents.en: Note that turning off the phone number verification toggle only prevents future linking.
sents.zh: 请注意，关闭电话号码验证开关只能防止未来的关联。

sents.en: If Google has already attached your number across secondary accounts, you will need to open your Google Account Personal Info page , head to Contact info > Phone , and manually remove the number from each profile where it doesn’t belong.
sents.zh: 如果谷歌已经将你的号码关联到了多个次要账户上，你需要打开谷歌账户的个人信息页面，前往联系信息 > 电话，并手动从每个不属于该号码的个人资料中将其移除。

paragraphs.en: Some Reddit users have complained that disabling phone number verification does not persist, and the option re-enables itself when you return to the above screen. While this particular report is a few months old, others have also complained about the same in the first thread. However, we were unable to replicate the behavior. Disabling phone number verification sticks for us (for now).
paragraphs.zh: 一些 Reddit 用户抱怨说，关闭手机号验证的设置无法保存，当你回到上述界面时，该选项又会自动重新开启。 虽然这份报告已经过去几个月，但在第一个帖子中也有其他人抱怨过同样的问题。 不过，我们未能复现这一现象。 对我们来说，关闭手机号验证的设置是生效的（目前如此）。

sents.en: Some Reddit users have complained that disabling phone number verification does not persist, and the option re-enables itself when you return to the above screen.
sents.zh: 一些 Reddit 用户抱怨说，关闭手机号验证的设置无法保存，当你回到上述界面时，该选项又会自动重新开启。

sents.en: While this particular report is a few months old, others have also complained about the same in the first thread.
sents.zh: 虽然这份报告已经过去几个月，但在第一个帖子中也有其他人抱怨过同样的问题。

sents.en: However, we were unable to replicate the behavior.
sents.zh: 不过，我们未能复现这一现象。

sents.en: Disabling phone number verification sticks for us (for now).
sents.zh: 对我们来说，关闭手机号验证的设置是生效的（目前如此）。

paragraphs.en: We have reached out to Google for a statement on this opt-out behavior for phone number verification on Android. We’ll keep you updated when we learn more.
paragraphs.zh: 我们已联系谷歌，就安卓上电话号码验证的这一选择退出行为寻求声明。 一旦了解到更多信息，我们会及时向大家更新。

sents.en: We have reached out to Google for a statement on this opt-out behavior for phone number verification on Android.
sents.zh: 我们已联系谷歌，就安卓上电话号码验证的这一选择退出行为寻求声明。

sents.en: We’ll keep you updated when we learn more.
sents.zh: 一旦了解到更多信息，我们会及时向大家更新。
